# cloudxino_container_registry (Data Source)

A Container Hub (CCH) registry of the team, by `id` or `name`. Registries are made in the console; give its `id` to a `cloudxino_container_host`'s `registry_ids` to pull private images from it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A Container Hub registry made in the console. Push images to <endpoint>/<image>:<tag>, then let a
# container host pull them with registry_ids.
data "cloudxino_container_registry" "hub" {
  name = "my-hub"
}

resource "cloudxino_container_host" "apps" {
  name         = "apps"
  plan         = "s-2vcpu-4gb"
  registry_ids = [data.cloudxino_container_registry.hub.id]
  compose      = <<-EOT
    services:
      web:
        image: ${data.cloudxino_container_registry.hub.endpoint}/web:1.0
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) Image prefix: push and pull `<endpoint>/<image>:<tag>`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `status` (String) `active` once the registry can be used.
